incelemeNotu: Optional ad-free subscription (monthly or yearly, auto-renewable): on the home screen tap the ... menu (top right) > Premium. The same screen has "Restore purchases", the renewal terms and links to the privacy policy and the Terms of Use (EULA). The app works fully without a subscription; the subscription only removes the ads. The light meter of the Android version is not offered on iPhone because iOS has no public ambient light sensor API.
